description: Every field a call to network may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

auth.description: how requests are signed: bearer (OAuth, JWT), basic, header or query (both named in authName), none; bearer when a line stores a token

authName.description: the header (`X-API-Key`) or query parameter (`api_key`) the token goes in, for auth header or query

baseURL.description: where the client sends unless told otherwise, `https://api.recipes.example`; the app may change it while it runs

coding.description: snake for snake_case JSON keys; exact when left out

dates.description: date formats the API writes beside ISO 8601, as patterns (`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`), or `seconds` or `milliseconds` for numbers

endpoints.description: one line an endpoint: `GET /v1/recipes/{id:Int}?full:Bool -> Recipe as recipe`, then `body(Type)` or `multipart(photo, caption:String?)`, `paged`, `stores token`, a quoted doc

entities.description: the types the endpoints send and answer, one line each: `Recipe "a dish": id Int, title String, minutes Int = 30, course Course?`; an enum is `Course: starter | main | dessert`

feeds.description: whether the client reads RSS, Atom and JSON Feed with `feed(at:)`; false when left out

into.description: the package's folder, relative to the project; Packages/<name> when left out

link.description: whether the package is linked into the project's app targets (an .xcodeproj) or its Package.swift; true when left out

name.description: the package, its library and module: `RecipeKit` (its types drop Kit: `RecipeClient`); API when left out

paging.description: page (a `page` number in the query) or cursor (a `cursor`, `page_cursor`, `max_id`, `after` or `page_token` query; the next one from the response or its Link header); read from the lines when left out
